hypotheses.H1: Legitimate sale of the advertised diamond
hypotheses.H2: Legitimate sale with exaggerated retail-value claims
hypotheses.H3: Genuine diamond shipped but different from advertised certificate
hypotheses.H4: Counterfeit, simulant, or materially misrepresented stone shipped
hypotheses.H5: Seller fails to fulfill the order
hypotheses.H6: Fraudulent impersonation of a legitimate diamond seller

matrix.diagnosticity: HIGH for existence of advertised certificate; LOW for fulfillment.

matrix.evidence: Advertised polish Excellent vs IGI Very Good
matrix.diagnosticity: MEDIUM — supports misstatement/exaggeration more than total fraud.

matrix.evidence: Public media identifies @royalediamondslive as Royale Diamonds auction seller
matrix.diagnosticity: MEDIUM against H6 (random impersonation); does not prove corporate legitimacy.
LOW — cheap can be liquidation or bait.

matrix.evidence: Community commentary: likely legit but often overpriced auctions
USPS tracking shows no public scan data yet / carrier portal blocked
matrix.diagnosticity: LOW on day-after purchase; becomes HIGH if stagnant past promised ship-by.

matrix.evidence: Ritani/Brilliance same-cert retail leads not independently reproduced
matrix.diagnosticity: LOW until reproduced; if reproduced, supports H2 value-claim context.

matrix.evidence: No verified enforcement action found against this TikTok seller
matrix.diagnosticity: LOW (absence of evidence ≠ evidence of absence).

subjective_bayes.caveat: Priors/likelihoods are explicitly subjective analytic judgments, not empirical base rates. Do not treat as precise probabilities.

key_assumptions: TikTok checkout payment actually captured funds from this seller account
User-advertised listing specs match what was shown in the livestream
USPS number provided belongs to this order
Absence of early tracking scans is normal for day-0/day-1 labels

seller_impersonation: Mismatched shop legal name vs livestream branding
shipping_nonfulfillment: No scan beyond label-created after promised ship-by + buffer
fake_tracking: Tracking number not recognized by USPS
unusual_refund_behavior: Pressure to accept store credit only
Refusal to use TikTok Shop dispute channel
